display.name: [Image-Provider] NGINX Metrics
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

display.name: Accepted connections
display.description: The total number of accepted client connections

spec.query:
SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, 'nginx_connections_accepted_total', toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

display.name: Connections handled
display.description: The total number of handled connections

spec.query:

display.name: Total number of client requests
display.description: The total number of client requests

spec.query:

display.name: Number of connections by state
display.description: The current number of nginx connections by state

spec.query:
SELECT sample.1 AS time, if(isFinite(sample.2), sample.2, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQueryRange(demo_metrics, 'nginx_connections_current', toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'), toIntervalSecond({step}))
ARRAY JOIN samples AS sample
ORDER BY time
